contentPattern.structure: full-bleed background image; left column with eyebrow, large title, content type | date details and one pill button with arrow

usage: Use for a full-width brand or campaign banner that introduces a topic with a strong image, a short headline and a single primary action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-backed banner with left-aligned text and one call to action. Use teaser-with-aem-coder for a side-by-side image and text layout.
